 Savannah Guthrie’s Thanksgiving Plans Confirmed as Mom Nancy Remains Missing
 Michelle Stein 
 November 20, 2026, 10:34 am 
 Comments 
 Don Arnold/WireImage via Getty Images 
 What To Know
 Savannah Guthrie will co-host Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade with Hoda Kotb and Al Roker on November 26.
 Her mother, Nancy Guthrie, remains missing after being last seen at her Tucson-area home on January 31.
 Savannah has pleaded for answers and offered a $1 million reward for information leading to an arrest; no suspect has been named.
 Savannah Guthrie ‘s Thanksgiving Day plans have been confirmed as her mom, Nancy Guthrie , remains missing following her February abduction in Tucson, Arizona.
 On Thursday, November 19, NBC announced that Savannah would once again help host the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade alongside her fellow Today hosts, Hoda Kotb and Al Roker .
 “Al, Hoda, and Savannah are BACK!” the network declared on Instagram . “Watch the Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade LIVE on Thursday, November 26, at 8:30 a.m. ET/PT on NBC and Peacock.”
 In the comments, fans rejoiced over the trio’s reunion, with one Instagram user declaring, “Yesssss SAVANNAH brightening my annual Thanksgiving Day is top tier.”
 Another shared, “Definitely can’t imagine my Thanksgiving without Al, Savannah and Hoda.”
 Yet another pointed out, “Thinking of Savannah, it’s got to be unimaginable to face the first holidays without her Mom, and still not have any closure.”
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by NBC Entertainment (@nbc) 
 Related 
 Nancy Guthrie Update: Retired FBI Agent Reveals What's 'Beyond Strange' About Case 
 Savannah’s most recent public message about her mother’s disappearance came on November 1, when she posted a photo of an old drawing from her daughter, Vale. “I know it might not seem like it, but I really need my mommy,” Vale wrote alongside a drawing of an umbrella under rain.
 “It says so much about how I feel,” Savannah captioned her Instagram update. “The world goes on, things appear ‘normal’ — as we try to keep going and be strong, especially for our young kids — but it’s not, and it never will be.”
 The NBC journalist continued, “For Annie and Tommy, for Cam and Kristine, for Mike and me and for all of Mom’s beloved grandchildren: we ache for her, we cry out for answers, we cannot move forward. We need someone to help us, tell us what you know. Our mom was a light in this world. We want to celebrate her and give her the dignity she deserves. The reward is still available. Please. We are begging you. Please help us.”
 To conclude the message, Savannah thanked followers for their kindness and invited them to keep “praying without ceasing” for her family.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by Savannah Guthrie (@savannahguthrie) 
 Nancy was last seen at her Catalina Foothills home on the evening of January 31. Since then, investigators have released photos of a masked suspect and published alleged ransom notes . Savannah has also offered a $1 million reward for information leading to an arrest. However, no suspect has been named.
 Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade,  Thursday, November 26, at 8:30 a.m. ET on NBC and Peacock
